purpose: Extend the existing WF40 primary-remote TRUE lane with a Tailscale-private read-only local-runtime contribution fetch, deterministic RESOURCE_STATUS composition, and explicit resource_status handoff into the already-installed sidecar-source adapter. Local endpoint failure is nonblocking and fail-closed: zero contributions are composed into canonical unavailable status. No technical requirements are inferred and no executor dispatch is added.
